defects: The opening headline 'Your agent writes the page.' collides with a blue firework ring through its baseline. The type and the bursts have no layering logic.
In the finale, the JSON spec line at the top sits on top of dense dotted rings and becomes unreadable.
During the mid-finale, the 'ANIKIT' dot wordmark forms on top of the shells and is unreadable while it assembles.
There is near-empty dead air: some frames hold only a couple of 1px rocket trails and one mono line on a flat gradient (seconds 0-3 and around 0.05 in the second pass), and they hold too long.
Rocket trails are thin hairline rectangles with no taper, glow or motion blur. They read as UI ticks, not light.
The audio has a hard low-pass sweep into near-silence from about 17.5 to 20 s, with a dead gap and a click-like transient at the 20 s cut. It plays as a technical reset, not a designed breath.
The audio is brick-walled at about 19.5 kHz, and the burst 'whooshes' are identical broadband noise blocks repeated (around 3.5 s, 10 s, 12 s, 21 s, 22.5 s and 24 s).
The 20 s shot is far beyond the pacing benchmark. The Tuesday/Saturday split is a static side-by-side with no motion device linking the two halves.
gaps: Motion: the bursts expand radially at a near-uniform rate and fade, with no hang, droop or secondary crackle. Willows fall as stiff static strands instead of easing under gravity, and the camera never moves. The pyrotechnic physics that would give weight and awe are missing, and the 'same film twice' comparison is staged as a flat split screen instead of a choreographed reveal.

Sound: the same noise-burst whoosh and low tonal bed repeat with almost no variation in arrangement, and the sub-low is a static drone. A cheap filter sweep to silence replaces a designed transition. Launch thumps, crackle tails and spatial depth are needed to make the deterministic 'every note from JSON' claim feel produced, not generated.

Finish: the shapes are flat vector dots and hairlines on a gradient with only faint grain, and the only bloom is a single soft halo. There is no light falloff on the sky from the bursts, no additive glow where shells overlap, and type and particles fight each other in the dense frames. Several frames, especially the sparse ones, would not hold as posters.
